entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Hakha
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Diocese of Hakha is located in the Chin State and the Sagaing Division in northwestern Myanmar. It is a suffragan diocese of the archdiocese of Mandalay.
